name: London New Journey
desc:
Welcome to London: New Journey, a city with much potential, you can be anything you wish to be, whether that wish is to live a life of crime, or to live as a law abiding citizen. The opportunities are endless. 

[❗❗❗] The game is currently under a whitelist, to join pend to the group. 

[❗] This is a semi serious RP game, please follow the rules and use common sense to avoid being banned.
